name: @cadencr/service
description: Cadencr Rust backend service — HTTP/WebSocket API powering the desktop app.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/cargo-env.mjs cargo build --locked --release --bin cadencr-service && node ../../scripts/cargo-env.mjs pnpm copy:release && pnpm check:macos-runtime-deps
scripts.build:local: node ../../scripts/cargo-env.mjs cargo build --locked --profile local --bin cadencr-service && node ../../scripts/cargo-env.mjs node ./scripts/copy-service-binary.mjs local && pnpm check:macos-runtime-deps
scripts.build:debug: node ../../scripts/cargo-env.mjs cargo build && node ../../scripts/cargo-env.mjs pnpm copy:debug
